title: Flightradar24 Flight Altitude Leaderboard
dataSources: ADS-B aircraft snapshots (`adsb:aircraft`), personal flight logbook (`flight:log`), commute trips (`commute:trip`), transit arrivals (`transit:arrival`), geofence events (`geofence:event`), travel documents (`travel:document`), fare quotes (`airprice:quote`).
app: Home ADS-B receiver (dump1090/readsb/tar1090 JSON feed), personal flight logbook exports, commute/transit APIs, and phone geofence webhooks via Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightradar24:flight altitude_ft=*
| stats sum(altitude_ft) as total_value, avg(altitude_ft) as avg_value by callsign
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks callsign values by total and average altitude across Flightradar24 flight events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `altitude_ft` values for each Flightradar24 flight event and review total and average altitude by callsign.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total altitude.
grandmaExplanation: It finds which callsign shows the biggest altitude numbers in your Flightradar24 flight data.
